Crêpe

Very thin pancake

A crêpe is a very thin pancake cooked on a flat griddle. A typical batter for four people uses about 2 cups of milk, 1 cup of flour and 3 eggs.

  • History
  • Preparation
  • Variations

Preparation

Cooks pour about ¼ cup of batter into a hot pan and tilt it so the batter spreads thinly. A pan of 9 inches is common, heated to around 400°F.

  • Sweet fillings: sugar, lemon, jam.
  • Savoury fillings: ham, cheese, egg.

Variations

Buckwheat flour gives a darker, nuttier crêpe, often served with savoury fillings.
